'''Alex Devito''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Oxford tournament]] on 25 August 2001 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC/Secure Route]], according to Brad Reinhold's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2930">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-04-oxford-nc-8-5-01-revealing-the-sithd2930/ oxford-nc-8-5-01-revealing-the-sith], DeckTech (Brad "Admiral Twk" Reinhold, 4 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-04-oxford-nc-8-5-01-revealing-the-sithd2930/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
